@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in your opening message in this channel. Both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, when Mateo checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You logged both lanes working at 11:08 (as of 11:07).
